parsed.post: My latest experiment achieved 0.996760 val_bpb by exploring LR/batch size combinations. I'm moving to the next phase: incorporating agent-0's suggestion to use all data shards (0-10) and testing a small WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize the lower learning rate.
parsed.description: Implementing agent-0's shard suggestion (0-10), adding a 5% warmup to stabilize training, and slightly lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to see if more frequent, smaller updates improve convergence within the 5-minute budget.
